visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a woman in a sparkling silver, floor-length sequined gown standing on a stage. She is seen from a side-back perspective, holding a silver flute. To her left, another musician is visible playing a violin. The background is dominated by a large LED screen showing a red moon/sun graphic with traditional Chinese motifs. The stage floor is covered with a blue, gray, and beige patterned carpet, featuring stage monitors and black cables. (2) The camera moves to a medium close-up, front-side profile of the woman as she begins to play the flute. Her long dark hair is styled straight, and her expression is focused with her lips pursed against the mouthpiece. Her hands move rhythmically across the silver keys of the instrument. The lighting is bright and consistent with a professional event hall, creating reflections on her dress. (3) As the performance continues, digital overlays appear including musical staves with notes and various text boxes. The camera maintains a steady focus on the woman's upper body and the flute. The violinist remains in the background, out of focus. The setting remains a large, high-ceilinged banquet hall with visible stage equipment and lighting fixtures on the ceiling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 如果《月亮代表我的心》有一段民笛獨奏呢？ [Slogan]: What if The Moon Represents My Heart had a flute solo? (2) [Subtitle]: 這次演出的編制為弦樂四重奏配上長笛. [Slogan]: This performance was arranged for string quartet with flute. (3) [Subtitle]: 每一開始的獨奏旋律我設計從低音的音域開始. [Slogan]: At the very beginning, I designed the solo line to start from the lowest Do. (4) [Subtitle]: 把自己想像成笛器界的 Kenny G! 我是 Lily F! [Slogan]: I imagined myself as the Kenny G of the flute! I'm Lily F! (5) [Subtitle]: 這些花腔旋律彷彿月亮散發出亮光暈和雲霧. [Slogan]: These ornamental phrases paint halos and mist around the moon. (6) [Subtitle]: 前方高能!! 這段高音我臨時增加了花舌現代演奏技巧. [Slogan]: In the high register I suddenly added a flutter-tongue modern technique - a little surprise! (7) [Subtitle]: 是不是有種嘖嘖為之一亮的感覺 中秋節民俗風味! [Slogan]: Doesn't it feel like Mid-Autumn folk flavor? (8) [Subtitle]: 我使用很多16分音符 讓大家感受長笛靈動的音符. [Slogan]: I used many 16th notes to let the flute sound light and agile. (9) [Subtitle]: 最後是真 即興發揮. [Slogan]: Finally, true improvisation: (10) [Subtitle]: 和樂譜小小不同 配合這次的編制. [Slogan]: slightly different from the written score, adapting to this ensemble, (11) [Subtitle]: 跳脫出弦樂的音域 讓長笛的聲音更加亮麗跳出來. [Slogan]: leaping beyond the string range so the flute voice shines through. (12) [Subtitle]: 祝大家中秋節快樂 (っˆڡˆς) [Slogan]: Happy Moon Festival to all! (13) [Logo]: Full Ver. in YouTube Lily Flute 月亮代表我的心.
